ruleDefinitions.name: Potential File Overwrite Via Sysinternals SDelete
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of SDelete to erase a file not the free space

sequences.query: process_original_file_name = "sdelete\.exe" AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-h.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-z.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/\\?.*")))
